title.en: Telescopic cascode OTA with a cascode mirror load, and its testbench
title.zh: 套筒式共源共栅 OTA（单端，共源共栅镜像负载）及测试台

description.en: A single-ended telescopic cascode OTA with a cascode mirror load, in a testbench that supplies its three bias voltages. Schematic generated by the RNL solver.
description.zh: 单端套筒式共源共栅 OTA，共源共栅镜像负载，测试台提供三路偏置电压。原理图由 RNL 求解器生成。
